name: DORIAN VESK
bio: A Halvern insurance investigator who forgets nothing he has glanced at. Loom hired him to find Corvel Lane, the street Null Meridian erased. He wears a plain mask so witnesses remember what they said, not who wrote it down. A street is a lot of paperwork to lose.
catchphrase: I do not solve things. I ask until they solve themselves.

theme.tagline: Ask until the truth gives up.
